slides.title: Every source gets a named extraction method, landing in your Data Vault without new tools
bullets: We propose the extraction for all sources, as asked: one metadata-driven loading pattern on AWS, configured per source, not one script per feed.
Business keys follow the railway terms your operations people already use, documented in Finnish.
Your existing Data Vault 2.0 conventions and loader are reused; nothing new unless you ask.

columns.title: Extraction on AWS
boxes: CDC for databases (e.g. AWS DMS where supported)
API / event feeds for traffic data

slides.title: Technical gates protect operations: nothing reaches production in Q1
table: Every source has a method, owner and load frequency; Finnish railway-term glossary agreed with your team
Row counts reconcile to source, no load errors for 5 days
All Q1 work tested in non-production, release plan approved
